schemaRules: All records closed; exact four aliases; full patch versions preserved and compared. Default alias must resolve to a supported explicit profile. No environment values, user data, browser paths or credentials.
Identity comparison is exact structural equality including binary paths/hashes and alias mappings; no timestamps in comparable identity.

Read/hash executables before and after version probes; fail if replaced or changed. Reprobe alias resolution before and after collection. Collect actual OS with /usr/bin/sw_vers -productVersion and -buildVersion; mismatch fails.

Use fixed argv, shell:false, bounded output. Resolve Python PATH aliases to executable files; execute alias and resolved binary with -I -B fixed probe and compare self-reported realpath/version. Do not invoke arbitrary caller commands.

Outside the required host: collector fails. The required positive identity test explicitly skips on a nonmatching frozen host; it must never replace the positive witness with a passing rejection assertion. Strict zero-skip evidence capture therefore forbids P02 acceptance outside the frozen host. Missing expected aliases or tools on a matching host are failures, not skips.
